title: The Dark Truth About Attention
body:
Many people want attention.

Few people ask an important question:

"Why am I receiving it?"

Attention can come from success.
Attention can come from talent.
Attention can even come from controversy.

But not all attention is valuable.

The people who spend their lives chasing attention often lose themselves in the process. The people who focus on creating value usually attract attention naturally.

Don't make attention the goal.

Make excellence the goal.

The attention that follows will be more meaningful.

 "Chase growth, not attention; one creates the other."
meta_title: Why You Should Chase Growth, Not Attention | NIAT Insider
meta_description: Attention can come from success, talent or controversy. A NIAT student on why chasing it costs you, and why building real value brings attention anyway.
